cards.ex: Many companies now offer programs that allow consumers to offset emissions from flights.
cards.exUz: Ko'plab kompaniyalar hozirda iste'molchilarga parvozlardan chiqadigan chiqindilarni qoplash imkonini beruvchi dasturlarni taklif qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Atmosferaga chiqarilgan zararli moddalarni kamaytirish yoki yo'q qilish uchun qilinadigan harakatlar.

cards.ex: Environmental stewardship is crucial for the long-term health of our planet.
cards.exUz: Atrof-muhitni qo'riqlash sayyoramizning uzoq muddatli salomatligi uchun juda muhimdir.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhitni mas'uliyat bilan boshqarish va himoya qilish.

cards.ex: Building climate resilience in coastal communities is essential to protect them from rising sea levels.
cards.exUz: Qirg'oqbo'yi jamoalarida iqlim barqarorligini qurish, ularni dengiz sathining ko'tarilishidan himoya qilish uchun muhimdir.
cards.uzDef: Iqlim o'zgarishining ta'siriga moslashish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: The company is keen to improve its green credentials by investing in renewable energy.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya qayta tiklanadigan energiyaga sarmoya kiritish orqali o'zining ekologik ishonchliligini oshirishga intilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Shaxs, kompaniya yoki mahsulotning ekologik jihatdan mas'uliyatli ekanligini ko'rsatuvchi dalillar.

cards.ex: The transition to a circular economy is vital for reducing our environmental footprint.
cards.exUz: Aylanma iqtisodiyotga o'tish bizning atrof-muhitga ta'sirimizni kamaytirish uchun juda muhimdir.
cards.uzDef: Resurslardan qayta foydalanish va chiqindilarni kamaytirishga qaratilgan iqtisodiy model.

cards.ex: Local residents voiced concerns about the proposed wind farm near their village.
cards.exUz: Mahalliy aholi o'z qishlog'i yaqinida taklif qilinayotgan shamol fermasi haqida xavotirlarini bildirishdi.
cards.uzDef: Muammo yoki xavotir haqida gapirish, uni ochiq aytish.

cards.ex: Deforestation rates in the Amazon rainforest remain alarmingly high.
cards.exUz: Amazon o'rmonida o'rmon kesish darajasi juda yuqori bo'lib qolmoqda.
cards.uzDef: O'rmonlarning yo'q qilinish tezligi yoki miqdori.

cards.ex: Forests play a vital role in carbon sequestration, helping to mitigate climate change.
cards.exUz: O'rmonlar uglerodni saqlashda muhim rol o'ynaydi va iqlim o'zgarishini yumshatishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Atmosferadan uglerodni olib tashlash va uni saqlash jarayoni.

cards.ex: New regulations are needed to curb emissions from industrial plants.
cards.exUz: Sanoat korxonalaridan chiqadigan chiqindilarni cheklash uchun yangi qoidalar kerak.
cards.uzDef: Zararli moddalarni chiqarishni kamaytirish yoki nazorat qilish.

cards.ex: Maintaining ecological balance is essential for the health of our planet.
cards.exUz: Ekologik muvozanatni saqlash sayyoramiz salomatligi uchun zarurdir.
cards.uzDef: Tabiatdagi turli organizmlar va ularning muhiti o'rtasidagi muvozanat.

cards.ex: Stricter environmental legislation is needed to protect our natural resources.
cards.exUz: Tabiiy resurslarimizni himoya qilish uchun qat'iyroq ekologik qonunchilik kerak.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhitni himoya qilishga qaratilgan qonunlar va qoidalar.

cards.ex: Reducing food waste is a simple but effective way to help the environment.
cards.exUz: Oziq-ovqat chiqindisini kamaytirish atrof-muhitga yordam berishning oddiy, ammo samarali usulidir.
cards.uzDef: Yeyilmasdan tashlab yuborilgan oziq-ovqat mahsulotlari.

cards.ex: The government needs to adopt measures to combat air pollution.
cards.exUz: Hukumat havo ifloslanishiga qarshi kurashish uchun chora ko'rishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni hal qilish yoki vaziyatni yaxshilash uchun qadamlar tashlash.

cards.ex: Plastic pollution poses a serious threat to marine life.
cards.exUz: Plastik ifloslanishi dengiz hayoti uchun jiddiy xavf tug'diradi.
cards.uzDef: Dengizda yashovchi o'simlik va hayvonlar.

cards.ex: Companies should adopt sustainable practices to reduce their environmental impact.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyalar atrof-muhitga ta'sirini kamaytirish uchun barqaror amaliyotlarni qabul qilishlari kerak.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhitga zarar yetkazmaydigan va resurslarni kelajak avlodlar uchun saqlaydigan usullar.

cards.ex: Certain chemicals can deplete the ozone layer, increasing UV radiation.
cards.exUz: Ayrim kimyoviy moddalar ozon qatlamini buzishi va ultrabinafsha nurlanishini oshirishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ozon qatlamini buzish, yupqalashtirish.

cards.ex: Solar energy has untapped potential to power our cities.
cards.exUz: Quyosh energiyasi shaharlarimizni quvvatlantirish uchun foydalanilmagan imkoniyatga ega.
cards.uzDef: Hali to'liq ishlatilmagan yoki rivojlantirilmagan imkoniyatlar.

cards.ex: Ignoring climate change will have dire consequences for future generations.
cards.exUz: Iqlim o'zgarishiga e'tibor bermaslik kelajak avlodlar uchun og'ir oqibatlarga olib keladi.
cards.uzDef: Jiddiy va yomon natijalar.

cards.ex: We need to address the issue of water scarcity before it's too late.
cards.exUz: Suv tanqisligi muammosini kech bo'lmasidan hal qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni ko'rib chiqish va uni hal qilishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: We can all reduce our environmental footprint by making small changes in our daily lives.
cards.exUz: Kundalik hayotimizda kichik o'zgarishlar qilish orqali barchamiz ekologik izimizni kamaytirishimiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Inson faoliyatining atrof-muhitga ta'siri.

cards.ex: The Amazon rainforest is at a tipping point, with large areas facing irreversible damage.
cards.exUz: Amazon o'rmoni hal qiluvchi nuqtada, katta hududlar qaytarilmas zarar ko'rmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyat o'zgarishi mumkin bo'lgan nuqta.

cards.ex: The destruction of natural habitats is a major threat to biodiversity.
cards.exUz: Tabiiy yashash joylarining yo'q qilinishi biologik xilma-xillik uchun katta xavfdir.
cards.uzDef: Hayvonlar va o'simliklarning tabiiy yashash muhiti.

cards.ex: Volunteers are helping to clean up the beach after the storm.
cards.exUz: Ko'ngillilar bo'ronlardan keyin sohilni tozalashga yordam bermoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ifloslangan joyni tozalash.

cards.ex: Companies must comply with environmental regulations to avoid fines.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyalar jarimalardan qochish uchun ekologik qoidalarga rioya qilishlari kerak.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish qoidalari.

cards.ex: Extreme weather events are becoming more frequent due to climate change.
cards.exUz: Iqlim o'zgarishi tufayli ekstremal ob-havo hodisalari tez-tez sodir bo'lmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ob-havo bilan bog'liq voqealar (bo'ron, qurg'oqchilik, toshqin va h.k.).

cards.ex: We need to raise awareness about the importance of water conservation.
cards.exUz: Suvni tejash muhimligi haqida xabardorlikni oshirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammo haqida odamlarning bilimini oshirish.

cards.ex: Politicians often try to shift the blame for environmental problems onto each other.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchilar ko'pincha atrof-muhit muammolari uchun aybni bir-biriga ag'darishga harakat qilishadi.
cards.uzDef: Aybdorlikni boshqa odamga yoki narsaga yuklashga urinish.

cards.ex: An environmental impact assessment is required before any major construction project can begin.
cards.exUz: Har qanday yirik qurilish loyihasi boshlanishidan oldin ekologik ta'sirni baholash talab etiladi.
cards.uzDef: Loyiha yoki faoliyatning atrof-muhitga ta'sirini baholash.

cards.ex: Reducing greenhouse gas emissions is crucial to mitigating climate change.
cards.exUz: Issiqxona gazlarini kamaytirish iqlim o'zgarishini yumshatish uchun juda muhimdir.
cards.uzDef: Atmosferada issiqlikni ushlab turadigan gazlar.

cards.ex: We need to find sustainable solutions to address the world's energy needs.
cards.exUz: Dunyoning energiya ehtiyojlarini qondirish uchun barqaror yechimlar topishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq muddatli va atrof-muhitga zarar yetkazmaydigan yechimlar.
